text: 3.5 1 The course was a lot more challenging than I expected. 2 We can see that by far the most affordable form of transport is walking. 3 The risks of driving a car are considerably more significant than those of flying. 4 For me, flying is much more comfortable than travelling by train. 5 Taking a train is definitely more relaxing than driving. 6 Using the underground is a lot faster than travelling by bus at rush hour. 7 Driving is considerably more expensive than walking. 8 Cycling is absolutely the healthiest form of transport.
